text: Wall Street just had the worst day of this selloff. The Nasdaq crashed more than five percent.
The S&P 500 fell three point seven percent, its seventh straight loss, and more than eight percent this week alone.
Blow one: Reuters reported that the SEC is examining Nvidia's accounting. Nvidia fell fourteen percent. AMD and Broadcom, down twelve or more.
Blow two: President Trump threatened a tremendous tax on companies that build AI data centers overseas.
Blow three: the AI doubts never left. Not Nvidia's earnings, not Anthropic's IPO could stop the selling.
Now the Nasdaq is negative for 2026, and the S&P 500 is in a correction.
Remember: a report is not a verdict. Nvidia has not been charged with anything. Long-term investors follow the facts, not the fear.
Your call: is this panic, or profit? Comment PANIC or PROFIT.
